product.name: Ingentis org.manager
product.description: With Ingentis org.manager, 2,000+ organizations analyze workforce and org data for M&A, succession, diversity strategies and more. Learn more about Ingentis org.manager

all_reviews.author_duration: Used the software for: Less than 6 months
all_reviews.review_description: Ingentis org.manager allows for easy chart creation and fast and easy access. The Ingentis team have been incredibly helpful throughout the sales and support process.
all_reviews.review_pros: With a user friendly design, the look and feel of this software is much more dynamic and modern than other software I have used in the past. The customisation capabilities allow for charts to be designed specifically to any business requirement.
all_reviews.review_cons: The depth of functionality, though it is awesome - adds some complexity that takes some time to fully understand.

all_reviews.review_title: Provides an ideal tool for responding to changes within organizations.
all_reviews.review_pros: Ingentis org.manager allows me to play in different organizational structures and figure out what it will look like if such change is made. This is much more refined for the strategic planning and takes out most of the speculation associated with the HR and organization development.
all_reviews.review_cons: It does not always have excellent compatibility with other Human Resource solutions in an organization. This leads to manual alteration or syncing which adds extra work in terms of time especially when undertaking strategic planning in an organization.

all_reviews.author_duration: Used the software for: Less than 6 months
all_reviews.review_pros: We have an integration directly with our existing HRM system - this allows us to visuaise our organisation data in a much more user friendly way. Up to date KPIs will improve speed of decision making and ongoing health checks of organisation data. Simulation tool will also save time and effort when discussing restructures with the business areas.
all_reviews.review_cons: Currently happy with all of the features but I'm sure as we start to use the system more now we have finished the implementation we will find areas for improvement or additio

all_reviews.review_description: Very beneficial to have insight into our associate structure. Easy to sign in and view all of the data. The Simulation allows us to plan for organizational changes. The Dashboard allows us to have insight into key data points and analytics.
all_reviews.review_pros: It's very easy to navigate and customize for your views, dashboards, and data simulations.
all_reviews.review_cons: I don't have any cons about this software.

all_reviews.review_title: Important tool for the user with Successfactor
all_reviews.author_duration: Used the software for: Less than 6 months
all_reviews.review_description: My experience with Ingentis org.manager has been overwhelmingly positive. We find the tool highly beneficial, particularly in the context of SuccessFactors. The visual representation of organizational charts is a standout feature, and despite minor constraints in template flexibility, the overall impact on our workflow is highly favorable.
all_reviews.review_pros: I appreciate Ingentis org.manager for its excellent visualization capabilities, especially when working with organizational charts within SuccessFactors. The tool provides an effective and visually appealing way to represent organizational structures.
all_reviews.review_cons: While Ingentis org.manager is a valuable tool, the print template from PowerPoint can sometimes be less flexible than desired. However, it remains a useful feature, and any limitations are outweighed by its overall utility.

all_reviews.review_title: Great service, support and an impressive software provided by Ingentis
all_reviews.review_description: The experience of working with Ingentis is great.
all_reviews.review_pros: We at ePillars are extremely happy with the services provided by Ingentis. It is a pleasure working with the company due to their friendly & extremely professional approach. We appreciate their quick support to us as a business partner. Org.manger is a great product with many add on features and so far there is a good demand in the Middle East market. We are confident that our client’s complicated requirements can be met easily using this software. We look forward to work with them on a long term business relationship.
all_reviews.review_cons: The configurations associated to the software seems to be little complex therefore we seem to have lot more to explore regarding the capability of the product.

all_reviews.review_description: very good, we are happy with the product and the customer service
all_reviews.review_pros: easily to develop as a adminstrator and change small things in a short time
all_reviews.review_cons: everythings fine, we dont use a lot of features

all_reviews.author_duration: Used the software for: Less than 6 months
all_reviews.review_description: very useful tool to create orgchart
all_reviews.review_pros: liaison with SAP HCM ease to use visualization the rapidity of org chart creation vendor's support (especially of help and support received by [SENSITIVE CONTENT]. his knowledge of Russian language is perfect)
all_reviews.review_cons: non possibility to create company's orgchart book on several pages (20 pages, not 200 pages) with possibility to see all data in the boxes

all_reviews.review_description: Great org charts and a lot of functionalites. The implementation partner is a great help and always available for me. Very easy going and reult-oriented!
all_reviews.review_pros: Integration to Workday was easy to setup. It is nice that it works through Workday reports. The tool has a lot of possibilites with manipulations and rules. The look of the org chart can be personalized a lot.
all_reviews.review_cons: In my opinion the org converter itself is very complex and even though I have received a training, I would not be able to maintain it by myself. Small things I can do but for more complex configurations I am in contact with our Implementation partner. But in my case it was never the intention that I would administrator it by myself.

all_reviews.review_title: Great combination of People with great attitude and a robust Technology!
all_reviews.author_profession: Global SAP HR Operational team lead
all_reviews.review_description: We implemented general reporting structure (org.chart) + some specific views with metrics, org.units only and data quality structure.
all_reviews.review_pros: - Out of the box integration with SAP HR and SuccessFactors - Choice between on-premise and cloud versions - Flexibility - Configuration simplicity - Time to implementation - Implementation consultants from vendor - Cost is acceptable
all_reviews.review_cons: The platform allows to configure almost everything someone could imagine, but customer implementation team has to be very creative to use all the capabilities (joke). In reality - the product has no cons!

all_reviews.review_title: Sehr schönes Produkte, welches zeitgemäß und einfach zu bedienen ist.
all_reviews.author_duration: Used the software for: Less than 6 months
all_reviews.review_pros: - Das Produkt lässt sich im Gegensatz zu anderen Produkten sehr einfach in den laufenden Betrieb implementieren. - Durch die einfache Installation hatten wir bereits nach kürzester Zeit große Erfolgserlebnisse.
all_reviews.review_cons: Für die Zukunft wäre es wünschenswert, wenn die Boxen zur Anzeige eines Mitarbeiters mit einem 3D Effekt belegt werden könnten.

all_reviews.author_duration: Used the software for: Less than 6 months
all_reviews.review_pros: Facile à utiliser, intuitif et des fonctionnalités très intéressantes comme la création de simulations. Facilité au niveau de la naviguation dans l'outil. Esthétique agréable. Bon interfacage avec Success Factor.
all_reviews.review_cons: Un des plus gros point faible est que lorsque l'on recherche une personne, nous ne la voyons pas automatiquement (pas de mise en valeur avec une couleur ou autre) et nous sommes obligé de la chercher parmis toutes les personnes. Temps de réponse parfois long

all_reviews.review_title: Flexibel konfigurierbares Programm zur Visualisierung von Organigrammen
all_reviews.review_description: Unsere Erfahrung mit Ingentis und dem org.manager sind sehr gut. Wir sind sehr zufrieden mit der Umsetzung des Projektes und den bisherigen nachträglichen individuellen Wünschen von unserer Seite. Der Ingentis Support und unsere Ansprechpartnerin sind immer gut zu erreichen, mit angenehm schnellen Reaktionszeiten und stehen uns natürlich in allen Fragen technisch kompetent zur Seite. So fühlen wir uns verstanden und gut aufgehoben. Vielen Dank.
all_reviews.review_pros: Für uns von Vorteil ist die Darstellung unserer Daten und Strukturen aus SAP heraus in einem verständlichen übsichtlichen Diagramm. Und darüber hinaus auch die individuellen Möglichkeiten des Programms, mit den Daten weiter zu arbeiten und diese nach Wunsch des Kunden darzustellen.
all_reviews.review_cons: Bisher konnten wir keine Nachteile feststellen. Als kleinen umständlichen Punkt möchten wir vielleicht die eigentliche technische Konfiguration des Diagramms erwähnen. Diese könnte zukünftig evtl. sofern möglich, etwas einfacher für den Endkunden gestaltet werden.

all_reviews.author_duration: Used the software for: I used a free trial
all_reviews.review_pros: Molto utile per la gestione dei dati delle risorse umane
all_reviews.review_cons: Non ho trovato nessun difetto in questo servizio

all_reviews.review_description: Die Kundenbetreuung war top - wir hatten noch nie eine so guten Consultant!
all_reviews.review_pros: Der neue Ingentis Org.Manager ist nochmal einen Tickent anwenderfreundlicher, sieht schick aus und das KPI Dashboard ist ein absoluter Mehrwert für HR Analytics
all_reviews.review_cons: Derzeit gib es keine negativen Erfahrungen

all_reviews.review_description: Die Schwachstellen in der grafischen Aufbereitung von Geschäftsdaten aus SAP heraus haben wir mit Ingentis gut gemeistert
all_reviews.review_pros: Bislang haben wir jegliche Anforderung in Richtung Design und Auswertung realisiert bekommen. Die professionelle Beratung beim Umsetzen unserer Anforderungen.
all_reviews.review_cons: Die Komplexität zur Abbildung im Org Converter ist immens. Ohne einen guten Berater ist das für nicht ITler nicht zu meistern. Den guten Berater haben wir von Ingentis :-)

all_reviews.review_title: Great software and a great software provider
all_reviews.review_description: Ingentis org.manager is a strong software with a lot of potential use cases and the support of the provider is great.
all_reviews.review_pros: he software is easy to use for the end users, multipurpose and individual for the company´s objects.
all_reviews.review_cons: There are a lot of adjustment possibilities for the administrator what makes it quite difficult to admin the software without the beautiful support of ingentis.

all_reviews.review_title: Super Tool zur Darstellung der Unternehmensstruktur
all_reviews.review_pros: - die sehr übersichtliche, visuelle Anzeige der Unternehmensstruktur - der einfach Abruf von Unternehmenskennzahlen - sehr gute Betreuung durch den Kundenberater
all_reviews.review_cons: Einen wesentlichen Nachteil an der Software gibt es aus unserer Sicht nicht.

all_reviews.review_title: Individuelles Organigramm mit vielen Zusatzfunktionen und Auswertungsmöglichkeiten
all_reviews.review_pros: - Alle Designwünsche konnten realisiert bekommen - Das Consulting bis zum Go live spitze - Die Möglichkeit aus unterschiedlichsten Datenquellen Daten sehr strukturiert darzustellen und Auswertungen zu erzeugen
all_reviews.review_cons: Der Org Converter ist sehr komplex. Wer nicht regelmäßig damit arbeitet, sollte im engen Austausch mit Ingentis stehen, falls Änderungen vorgenommen werden sollen.

all_reviews.review_pros: Einfache Anbindung an bestehendes DATEV System
all_reviews.review_cons: Insgesamt guter Eindruck, einfache Handhabung - auch in der Adminfunktion

all_reviews.review_description: Ingentis helps us to visualise the organisation and and further information e.g. e-mail and telefon number. It creates more transparancy based on this informations.
all_reviews.review_pros: Especially in the beginning, the system is very complex due to the countless possibilities. However, because of the workshops offered for the design, we learned the basics quick. Due to the good support, it was quickly possible to get the system in place.
all_reviews.review_cons: On the other hand, the complexity is also a cons. Because you can do everything with the tool, we need to ask sometimes for support.

all_reviews.author_duration: Used the software for: Less than 6 months
all_reviews.review_description: Einfache Visualisierung von Organigrammen. Alles Kundenwünsche wurden umgesetzt.
all_reviews.review_pros: Einfache Einrichtung mit tollen Nutzungsmöglichkeiten
all_reviews.review_cons: Mir fällt nichts Negatives ein. Rundum zufrieden!

all_reviews.author_profession: Head of HR Services and Systems
all_reviews.review_description: Aus der Enbenutzer-Perspektive super intuitiv, optisch ansprechend und mit der von uns definierten Funktionalität (Orgchart Struktur, Kennzahlen, Filter, Reports).
all_reviews.review_pros: Wir haben ingentis org.manager als einen extrem flexibles Tool bzgl. der Darstellungsmöglichkeiten von Organisationsstrukturen und zugehöriger Kennzahlen, inkl. der Möglichkeit diese in Offline-Formate (e.g. PDF/PPT) zu exportieren schätzen gelernt. Weiterhin hat uns die Fähigkeit überzeugt mit dem Tool künftige Organisationsänderungen simulieren zu können, bzw. diese gegen die aktuelle Organisationsstruktur (oder eine historische) vergleichen zu können. Die Integration mit unserem HRIS erfolgte mit SAP "Bordmitteln" und wurde von ingentis sehr gut unterstützt.
all_reviews.review_cons: Der einzige erwähnenswerte "Nachteil" den wir nach zwei Jahren Nutzung erkennen konnten ist, dass mit viel Flexibilität in der Natur der Sache liegend zwangsläufig auch ein gewisser Design-, Konfigurations- und Beratungsaufwand kommt, selbst wenn die technische Umsetzung unserer Designs durch ingentis dann in der Folge zeitnah und mit vertretbarem Aufwand erfolgte.

all_reviews.review_title: A Highly Customizable and Valuable Tool
all_reviews.review_description: As I mentioned above, the overall experience has been very satisfying, and that’s considering that we are not yet exploring all the options and functionalities that the tool offers. Even when using only the basic features, they provide a high level of customization, ensuring that the org manager truly becomes a useful tool, not only for visualization but also for analysis and for supporting decision-making by leaders and HR.
all_reviews.review_pros: The standard solutions offered by Ingentis are very diverse, and above all, I value the flexibility and customization options to adapt to the customer’s needs. In addition, the support throughout the entire process has been excellent, both in terms of the quality and the speed of the service.
all_reviews.review_cons: At this point, I don’t have any negative feedback to provides. The service that Ingentis has provided to me so far has been excellent.

all_reviews.review_title: Ingentis org.manager is a great tool!
all_reviews.review_description: Ingentis is an easy-to-use tool. Their customer service department is very responsive and helpful. I highly recommend this tool.
all_reviews.review_pros: Ingentis is a great tool as it allows us to pull great reports with precise information for our diagrams. The value for the money is great as well.
all_reviews.review_cons: It's easy to use and pull precise reports for our diagrams. We use flowcharts a lot in our business so this tool makes is very easy.
